messages.text:
Hi, one of the bitaxe's is telling me it has a power fault and to check my power supply. These power supplies are supposed to work longer than the 6 weeks or so arent they. Are they covered by a warranty?

Order Shop····

Yes — six weeks is well inside the 3-month RMA that comes with the unit, so you're covered.

Before we call it dead, though: that fault often comes from a loose power connector, they shake free in shipping. Unplug the PSU from the wall, pull the grey cover off the Bitaxe, and check the XT30 connector is screwed down tight.

Can you take a look?
Yes, give me a few minutes.
That seems to have corrected it for the time being. I'll let it run and let you know what it says on Monday when you guys are back in the office. :)

Good — sounds like it was just a loose connector. If the fault comes back, note the time it happened and tell us Monday; you're inside the RMA window either way, so nothing to worry about on that front.

Before you go, one thing: how many Bitaxes are you running, and what made you add more than one?
I bought the buy 2 BSB bitaxe get one free. I wanted to jump in to mining but not spend a bunch of money and these seemed like a great way to get my feet wet.
Makes sense. Six weeks in now — what would have to happen for you to step up to a bigger unit?
as per usual, money. I'm trying to save up for a bigger, better, faster unit but money is always the issue.
Fair enough — that's most people. Thanks for telling me, and enjoy the weekend. If that fault shows up again, we'll pick it straight up Monday.

context.pop: Anything I can clear up before you check out?
